context: Reduce hero vertical cost at desktop and wide breakpoints so at least two leaderboard rows fall above the fold, or re-baseline the budget only with an explicit recorded product rationale. Fix the layout first; treat a budget change as a last resort needing sign-off.
description: Newly discovered 2026-08-03 and previously invisible. responsive.spec.ts sets serial mode (line 35), so the stale-headline failure aborted the block before the remaining viewports ran. With the headline corrected locally, Chromium reports two real failures: 'home keeps headline, cohort summary, and leaderboard rows high in the viewport at desktop' and 'at wide', both failing responsive.spec.ts:81 with Expected >= 2, Received 1. Mobile and tablet pass. Only one leaderboard row now lands above the fold at large viewports, against a budget of two. Most likely cause is the taller hero introduced by #1482, which added ActiveLeaderboardSummary above the rows.
